name: zero serializes as 0
rationale: RFC 8785 §3.2.2.3: zero (including the -0 negative-zero form, which cannot be expressed in JSON) must produce the string '0'. JSON parsers normalize -0 to 0 when reading vectors; unit tests in the reference impl cover the JS-level -0 case directly.

name: large integer (Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)
rationale: RFC 8785 §3.2.2.3: large safe integers must round-trip without scientific notation.

name: negative integer
rationale: Negative integers must serialize with leading minus sign.

name: unicode key ordering: latin extended before ASCII z
rationale: RFC 8785 §3.2.3: keys are sorted by UTF-16 code unit value. 'a'=U+0061(97), 'z'=U+007A(122), 'é'=U+00E9(233). So order is a, z, é.

name: emoji key sorts after ASCII
rationale: RFC 8785 §3.2.3: emoji U+1F600 encodes as surrogate pair (U+D83D, U+DE00); both code units (55357, 56832) are greater than ASCII 'a' (97), so emoji key sorts after 'a'.
